_description: ±20% range, 30 levels. Backtested on three BTC market regimes: +3.9%/90d (+16%/yr) on lateral 2026, -4.6% loss on LUNA crash bear 2022 (stops after 10% of period), +0.2% on Oct-Jan 2024-25 bull run (stops after 28%). Recommended for general/uncertain conditions. Recalibrate grid_lower/grid_upper when BTC moves significantly (target ±20% from current price). Capital must equal grid_levels × grid_order_size_usdt.

_backtest.bear_2022: -4.6% loss — stops after 10% of period (LUNA crash -54%)
